snippet.title: Memory Lost | Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The action-packed top-down shooter Memory Lost is coming to PS4 & PS5 & Xbox consoles this June 12! Nintendo Switch version will be available later this year! 

Buy now: 
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/
Epic Games Store - https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/memory-lost-e53b90

Wishlist now:
PlayStation - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009187
Nintendo Switch - soon
Xbox - soon

——————————————————————————————————————————————————

Memory Lost is a story-driven, fast-paced cyberpunk shooter where you are not just fighting enemies — you become them. Possess enemies, adapt their weapons and skills, and fight ruthless corporations. Uncover secrets, upgrade abilities, and shape your own fate in this world.
